c4_disclosure.statement: Round 2: Exploratory values of the primary contrast (greedy minus uniform) and of the EXP-002 contrasts were seen before the freeze, at the DRAFT setting (h0 = 1 day, sigma = 0.75, pre-amendment greedy and Leitner rules), on exploratory seeds 1 to 30 (disjoint from all confirmatory seeds). No run at the frozen setting has computed any contrast: the only run at the fitted setting (PROBE-005) ran the uniform arm alone. The amendments were set by the owner's approvals and the calibration rule, not chosen from these values. Round 3 (v1.1): before the re-freeze the session saw (i) the held-out model comparison CAL-002 (no simulation), and (ii) the uniform arm's mean R at RI 1 to 365 days on exploratory seeds 1 to 30 (RI-001, PROBE-006). No arm other than uniform was simulated at the v1.1 setting and no contrast has been computed at any RI other than the draft-setting probes of round 1. The central RI was set by the pre-stated rule 16.2, not chosen from any contrast.
other_disclosures: Calibration CAL-001: held-out log-loss of the calibrated exponential curve 0.587 vs 0.328 for a constant predictor (model-form misfit).
Regime: baseline-only PROBE-005 at the fitted setting, mean uniform R 0.959 (exponential) and 0.810 (power law), seeds 1-30: near ceiling for EXP-001.
Session interpretation: 'cover every item' implemented as a coverage-first key (every item reviewed at least once), not a per-item quota (D-010).
Round 3: neither forgetting model beats a constant predictor of real first-review recall (CAL-002); results are conditional on the assumed memory model (claims boundary, protocol 16.3).
Round 3: the seed-spread estimate was not re-measured at RI 281 because it needs a contrast, which rule (b) forbids.
